Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Each writer commits independently here; this is not the merge two-phase commit.
BEGIN and synchronous_commit SET statuses are discarded. COPY helpers can exit the process
directly, bypassing the ordinary return/rollback branch. No lineage grouping occurs inside
this fold routine: its key is claim ID and its scope is the caller-provided source fold.
This does not establish complete dependence-root handling.
